b_executable_condition: Add HypnoticPatternAbility (56b8f0304a704a67b3c35cbe8c774854, ExpandedContent) to PsychicSharedSpellCatalog.cs; enforce atomic 90-spell validation in EsotericStarseeker0081.Register(cache) via RegisterAll and RegisterOptional; gate MajorGrant01460/PsychicMajor01460 at level 15 for EsotericStarseekerArchetype0081 without mutating PsychicSpellcasting blueprint fields.

cases.title: Level 1/11/15 Archetype Replacements & 6-Discipline Bonus Spell Stripping
assertions: Archetype RemoveFeatures at L1 removes DisciplineSelection and PhrenicAmplificationSelection.
Archetype AddFeatures at L1 adds EsotericStarseekerDisciplineSelection0081 and WrittenInTheStarsFeature0081.
Archetype RemoveFeatures at L11 removes PhrenicAmplificationSelection and MajorAmplifications (fdd7cee80b9e81640bc490e3eafb2742).
Archetype AddFeatures at L15 adds MajorAmplifications (fdd7cee80b9e81640bc490e3eafb2742) while keeping native L15 PhrenicAmplificationSelection.

EsotericStarseekerDisciplineSelection0081 exposes all 6 spell-less disciplines; selecting any of the 6 grants its Phrenic Pool stat routing and 1/5/13 discipline powers, but grants 0 discipline bonus spells at levels 1..20.

cases.title: Single Constellation Attunement (L1-10) & Castable-Circle-Only Grant + Level-Up Dynamic Unlock
assertions: At Psychic L1 (MaxSpellLevel == 1), attuning to a constellation grants ONLY its 1st-circle spell into the Psychic spellbook via UnitPartTemporarySpellsKnown (IsTemporary == true).
Circles 2..9 from the active constellation are NOT present in the Psychic spellbook at L1 (rejecting original CotW's 1..9 blanket grant).

When the character levels up to L4 (MaxSpellLevel == 2) and L6 (MaxSpellLevel == 3) while the constellation Buff remains active, ConstellationCircleSpell0081.HandleUnitGainLevel dynamically registers the newly unlocked 2nd-circle and 3rd-circle spells into UnitPartTemporarySpellsKnown and marks UISettings dirty.

At L1..10, at most 1 constellation Buff can be active at once; if a second activation occurs at L1..10, the prior constellation Buff and its temporary spells are removed before applying the new constellation.

cases.title: 11th-Level Dual Constellation Simultaneous Maintenance & FIFO Replacement on 3rd Attunement
assertions: At Psychic L11 (MaxSpellLevel == 5), WrittenInTheStarsResource0081 has MaxAmount == 2.

Attuning first to Comet (spends 1 resource, 1 remaining) and second to Dragon (spends 1 resource, 0 remaining) keeps BOTH WrittenInTheStarsCometBuff0081 and WrittenInTheStarsDragonBuff0081 active simultaneously.
Both Comet and Dragon grant their circles 1..5 spells into the Psychic spellbook simultaneously (2 constellation bonus spells per castable circle 1..5).

If resource is restored and a 3rd constellation (Rider) is attuned while Comet and Dragon are active, the oldest active constellation (Comet) is removed along with its temporary spells, leaving Dragon and Rider active.

cases.title: Full-Round Action, Duplicate-Constellation Block, Cancel, Buff Removal No-Refund & Rest Reset
assertions: WrittenInTheStarsAbility0081 and all 10 variant abilities are Supernatural, Personal range, Full-Round Actions.
WrittenInTheStarsResource0081 MaxAmount is exactly 1 at Psychic L1..10 and 2 at Psychic L11..20.
WrittenInTheStarsRestriction0081 blocks selecting a constellation whose Buff is already active on the caster, spending 0 resource.
Pre-cast cancellation or failed restriction check spends 0 resource.
Constellation Buffs have IsNotDispelable == true and BuffFlags.RemoveOnRest | BuffFlags.StayOnDeath.

Removing a constellation Buff manually, replacing it with another constellation, or clearing it does NOT refund WrittenInTheStarsResource0081 (fixing original CotW's ContextRestoreResource infinite-swap exploit).
Resting removes active constellation Buffs (via RemoveOnRest), cleans up their temporary spells from the Psychic spellbook, and restores WrittenInTheStarsResource0081 to full daily charges.

cases.title: Permanent Spell Preservation, Multi-Source Isolation, Undercasting Reconciliation & UI Refresh
assertions: If the Psychic already knows Magic Missile (L1) permanently (!IsTemporary), attuning to Comet and later removing WrittenInTheStarsCometBuff0081 preserves the permanent Magic Missile in the spellbook.

If a second temporary source (e.g. another temporary spell component) grants the same spell at the same circle as an active constellation, removing one source leaves the spell known via the remaining source until all temporary sources are removed.

Attuning to Courtesan at L18 (granting both L3 synesthesia and L9 synesthesia_mass) and later removing Courtesan reconciles PsychicUndercasting without deleting any pre-existing permanent lower-tier spell.
Activating, leveling up with, or deactivating a constellation Buff calls Owner.UISettings?.SetDirty().

cases.title: CopySpellbook Level-Up Preview Isolation, Permanent Promotion During Active Buff & Respec Cleanup
assertions: When UnitHelper.CopySpellbook runs while a constellation Buff is active, TemporaryKnowledge01464.RestoreCopy marks the constellation's spells in the copied preview spellbook as IsTemporary == true.
Constellation spells in the preview spellbook do not consume permanent SpellsKnown slots and do not prevent the player from selecting that same spell as a permanent known spell during level-up.

If the player permanently learns a spell during level-up while it is also granted by an active constellation, later removing the constellation Buff leaves the promoted permanent spell (!IsTemporary) intact.

When WrittenInTheStarsFeature0081 is removed/deactivated (e.g. respec/retraining), WrittenInTheStarsFeatureCleanup0081 removes all active constellation Buffs and cleans up all temporary constellation spells from the spellbook.

cases.title: Major Amplifications & Mimic Metamagic Eligibility at L11-14 vs L15+ and Non-Starseeker Control
assertions: For an Esoteric Starseeker at L11..14, MajorAmplifications (MajorId = fdd7cee80b9e81640bc490e3eafb2742) is NOT granted by either PsychicProgression or MajorGrant01460, even after OnPostLoad or HandleUnitGainLevel.
For an Esoteric Starseeker at L11..14, PsychicMajor01460.Has(owner) is false, blocking Major Amplifications and Mimic Metamagic (MimicMetamagicI/II/III) at L14 amplification selection.

For an Esoteric Starseeker at L15+, MajorAmplifications (MajorId) IS granted and retained across OnPostLoad/HandleUnitGainLevel, and PsychicMajor01460.Has(owner) is true, unlocking Major Amplifications and Mimic Metamagic.
For a standard Psychic or non-Starseeker archetype at L11, MajorAmplifications (MajorId) is still granted at L11 as normal, and PsychicClass blueprint fingerprint remains 100% unchanged.

cases.title: Atomic Rejection on Missing/Invalid Provider, Late-Load Completion & Idempotent Re-Entry
assertions: When any of the 5 external provider spells is missing from BlueprintsCache, disabled via PsychicSpellIntegration, or fails contract validation (wrong type/school/parent/un-executable/missing required spell list publication), EsotericStarseeker0081.Register(cache) returns false.
On rejection, zero 0081 blueprints exist in BlueprintsCache, PsychicClass.m_Archetypes does not contain EsotericStarseekerArchetype0081, and PsychicProgression.UIGroups is unchanged.

When the missing external provider spells are subsequently added to BlueprintsCache and RegisterOptional(cache) / EsotericStarseeker0081.Register(cache) runs, all 25 blueprints of EsotericStarseeker0081 publish atomically and connect to PsychicClass.

Calling EsotericStarseeker0081.Register(cache) or BlueprintRegistration.RegisterAll(cache) repeatedly on an already-published cache is 100% idempotent (no duplicate archetypes, UI groups, or assets; receipt Definition check passes).
